description:
## Problem
Trunk run 44996878729 (develop at 93f336032a) failed in tpcds-parity-draws: `57_expression: diverged in 1 of 2 runs; Q57: returned row 73 breaks the ORDER BY: sort key (-109.64909090909092, Decimal('20.18')), expected (-109.64909090909093, Decimal('265.34'))`. The two sort keys differ only in the last float digit, so floating-point summation order makes the order check non-deterministic. A failed-job rerun passed.

## Change
Find whether the expression backend's float aggregation is order-dependent, or whether the cross-surface ORDER BY check should compare float sort keys with a tolerance (treating near-equal keys as ties). Fix the cause; do not add Q57 to a skip list.

## Decision gates
- Decide from evidence which side is wrong: if the SQL reference and the expression backend legitimately produce different float sums, a tie tolerance in the ORDER BY check is the fix; the tolerance value and its scope (sort keys only, never result values) go to the owner in a choice dialog if it is wider than one unit in the last place.
- Never weaken value comparisons, add retries to the target, or narrow the draws or backends.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `make tpcds-cross-surface-draws-report` passes repeatedly (for example, 10 runs) with no Q57 divergence, and a test pins the tie behaviour.
Fail: Q57 skipped, retried, or value tolerances widened.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
